fixtureCorrections: FullscreenWeb moves the player into body; inspect actual controlsCenter/emitter ownership.
Pool nodes may be reused and then hidden by duplicate loops; inspect actual original-node text/use and record extra allocations, not assume final visible identity.
priorFailure.unresolvedProductionObservation: Two simultaneous fixed comments occupied y=10 in the initial strict geometry test, with duplicate native start events and repeated worker IDs. The subsequent 48-case pass does not close the historical race; the strict overlap assertion remains active.

limitations: Only actual plugin 5.3.0 main/legacy native browser behavior; controlled source/legacy failures are separate.
The native core matrix is actual published 5.4.0 and candidate 5.4.1; no inferred continuous support range.
Load/heap/frame metrics are short-run observations, not a leak proof, performance threshold or long-term stability clearance.
Historical repeated-loop overlap remains open and can make the strict concurrency regression fail on later runs.
No real Bilibili service, CSP restriction matrix, physical Safari/mobile, Mask model or npm release readiness acceptance.

priorLoadFixtureFailure.cause: Test read non-existent art.paused; corrected to art.template.$video.paused. No production change.

rawObservationPolicy: Large layout/event/frame arrays remain in the hash-bound raw Playwright reports. This maintained summary retains counts, selected geometry, input identities and sample metrics.
